response: PR #3729 (OMN-20912) adds six typed read operations — workflow_runs, run_jobs, job_log_tail, artifacts, pr_text, and releases — to node_github_repo_gateway_effect, each returning its own typed result in the existing discriminated union, with default/capped limits (limit 30/300, tail_bytes 16 KiB/64 KiB, max_bytes 256 KiB/512 KiB), Link rel="next" pagination with truncation flagging, and refusals for out-of-cap downloads, expired or foreign-run artifacts, and next links leaving the API root. These typed reads support the OMN-20912 PR authoring write effect with claim and quota guards.
